mapper.sql: c.*, s.code AS supplier_code, s.name AS supplier_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, t.tender_no, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED' THEN ROUND(oi.done_qty * oi.price, 2) ELSE oi.amount END), 0) FROM scm_order o JOIN scm_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.contract_id = c.id AND o.status <> 'DRAFT') AS ordered_amount
FROM scm_purchase_contract c LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = c.supplier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.create_by LEFT JOIN scm_tender t ON t.id = c.tender_id
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.contract_no, c.name, c.supplier_id, c.contract_type, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.amount_limit, c.status FROM scm_purchase_contract c WHERE c.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.start_date <= #{date} AND c.end_date >= #{date} ORDER BY c.end_date

SELECT oi.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED' THEN oi.done_qty ELSE oi.qty END) AS ordered_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED' THEN ROUND(oi.done_qty * oi.price, 2) ELSE oi.amount END) AS ordered_amount, SUM(oi.done_qty - oi.return_qty) AS received_qty FROM scm_order o JOIN scm_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.contract_id = #{contractId} AND o.status <> 'DRAFT' AND o.id <> #{excludeOrderId} GROUP BY oi.material_id

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.order_date, o.status, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.supplier_confirm, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.done_qty - i.return_qty), 0) FROM scm_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS done_qty FROM scm_order o WHERE o.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT c.payment_days FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id JOIN scm_purchase_contract c ON c.id = o.contract_id WHERE d.id = #{tradeDocId}
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_purchase_contract SET status = #{to}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
